# kion_funding_source_note (Resource)

Manages a Kion Funding Source Note.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_funding_source_note" "example" {
  # Optional
  # funding_source_id = 1
  # name              = "example"
  # text              = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `funding_source_id` (Number) ID of the funding source the note belongs to.
- `name` (String) Name of the note.
- `text` (String) Body text of the note.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
